messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
We spent the rest of the day riding on rollercoasters-some of which I swear, re-arranged my internal organs and left my brain temporarily in the stratosphere.

output.original_text: We spent the rest of the day riding on rollercoasters-some of which I swear, re-arranged my internal organs and left my brain temporarily in the stratosphere.
output.joy: We spent the rest of the day joyfully riding rollercoasters—some of which I swear, playfully re-arranged my internal organs and sent my brain soaring into the stratosphere!
output.sadness: We spent the rest of the day riding rollercoasters, some of which I swear, painfully jumbled my internal organs and left my brain drifting aimlessly in the stratosphere.
output.fear: We spent the rest of the day riding rollercoasters—some of which I swear, terrifyingly re-arranged my internal organs and left my brain plummeting into the stratosphere.
output.anger: We spent the rest of the day on those damn rollercoasters—some of which I swear, recklessly re-arranged my internal organs and left my brain lost in the stratosphere!
output.surprise: We spent the rest of the day riding rollercoasters—some of which I swear, shockingly re-arranged my internal organs and catapulted my brain into the stratosphere!
output.disgust: We spent the rest of the day riding those gross rollercoasters—some of which I swear, sickeningly re-arranged my internal organs and left my brain suspended in the stratosphere.
